roadmap_gap_summary.roadmap_phase_goal: first loadable Zigux runtime modules with selftest hooks and runtime module lifecycle parity
roadmap_gap_summary.missing_capability: shared runtime substrate that can turn the bounded register_kretprobe and unregister_kretprobe handoff plan into a real loadable module path
roadmap_gap_summary.blocked_deliverable: loadable Phase 9 runtime kretprobe pilot module parity
roadmap_gap_summary.next_gate: keep the loader scaffold, shared-request lifecycle proof, and prepared-plan drift guard explicit until the shared runtime loader substrate can consume the handoff plan

gaps.why_now: A bounded loader plan keeps the register_kretprobe and unregister_kretprobe lifecycle explicit through prepared, initialized, selftest-complete, and release-without-substrate handoff proofs without implying live runtime registration parity.

The current requestSharedRuntimeLoad review surface still needs an explicit prepared-plan drift guard before the sample-side loader advances to waiting_on_runtime_substrate, so shared request drift cannot desynchronize the local kretprobe loader stage from the shared runtime_loader request state during compile and selftest review.
The roadmap's loadable runtime pilot module step still depends on shared runtime-loader support before any honest claim of real register_kretprobe parity.
